 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 All I want for Christmas... is John McGlynn.
 Magnus 
 If only there was a Scottish manager out there who played attractive football, had an eye for a player, and gave young players confidence and game time...
 Jack in Falkirk

 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 A teasing Kieran Tierney cross clips off two Swiss players and sits up perfectly for Scott McTominay to somehow blast over from close range.
 Sitter.
 66 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 How's there still 20 minutes to go here?
 Jeez.
 81 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:16 GMT 21:16 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Scotland winger on BBC Sportsound 
 Scotland have improved a bit since the substitutions. Gannon-Doak's pace is giving the Swiss something to think about.
 54 117 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 It's probably worth remembering that Steve Clarke resigned. He wasn't sacked.
 Granted, a lot of fans wanted change.
 127 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 If Pocognoli is still in a job tomorrow, the entire board that appointed him needs fired as well. Absolutely shocking! I’m embarrassed by every performance under this manager. 
 Gary 
 What we'd give for a stable manager with some tactical nous, who could guide us to three out of four tournaments...
 Michael 
 248 81 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 It's slapstick stuff from both sides as an injured Kieran Tierney plays Samuel Ballet onside. He then attempts to beat Angus Gunn before Zeki Amdouni tries to be too smart with the follow-up.
 Scotland all over the place.
 112 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:10 GMT 21:10 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 Andy Robertson is trying to press like a demon in the Switzerland box.
 The captain's record cap is being soured in St Gallen.
 91 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:08 GMT 21:08 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 Decent approach play from Scotland, but the final pass is lacking again. Ben Gannon-Doak then tries to nod in a Ryan Christie cross at the back post, but he just can't get there.
 44 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 This formation clearly isn’t working. We have no width, leaving huge holes at left and right-back. I’ve never seen such an obvious error in formation not be corrected by a manager. 
 Ewan 
 To all the people who wanted Steve Clarke out - are you happy now?
 Jeff 
 Hopeless. Defence is non-existent, midfield ineffective and nothing up front. Probably one of the worst Scotland teams ever and as for the manager I don’t know what game he’s trying to play.
 Tam 
 416 46 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 Scott McTominay with another ambitious one, shanking a shot on the bounce miles off target.
 74 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:05 GMT 21:05 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 Ryan Christie is coming on for his 76th Scotland cap, putting him up to joint ninth in the all-time list.
 Kieron Bowie and Ben Gannon-Doak are also entering the field.
 It's another game without a goal for Oli McBurnie, who comes off with John McGinn and Billy Gilmour.
 67 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'We're getting punished for mistakes' published at 21:03 GMT 21:03 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 Scott Brown 
Former Scotland captain on BBC Scotland 
 There are always going to be questions asked of the manager after a 3-0 defeat. The first half wasn't that bad a performance, second half we have started slowly.
 We're getting punished for our mistakes. 
 146 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:01 GMT 21:01 GMT 
 Switzerland 3-0 Scotland 
 Speaking of Denmark last year, Scott McTominay has just attempted a bicycle kick.
 This one's quite rubbish.

 Tactical masterclass feels kind, Alan, but we take your point.
